dish.title: Ukrainian Beet Borscht with White Beans and Dill
dish.description: A ruby-red vegetable borscht of beets, cabbage, carrot, potato, and white beans in a tomato-and-vinegar broth sweetened with a little sugar and finished with garlic and fresh dill. Served with rye bread.

recipe_version.title: Ukrainian Beet Borscht with White Beans and Dill
recipe_version.description: A ruby-red vegetable borscht of beets, cabbage, carrot, potato, and white beans in a tomato-and-vinegar broth sweetened with a little sugar and finished with garlic and fresh dill. Served with rye bread.

ingredients.name: rye bread
ingredients.note: store-bought, a loaf with no milk or butter on the ingredient list; serve on the side

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Peel the beets and carrot and grate them on the large holes of a box grater. Dice the onion, shred the cabbage, and peel and cube the potatoes. Drain and rinse the beans, grate the garlic, and chop the dill.

steps.title: Sauté the base
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 7-quart pot over medium. Cook the onion and carrot, stirring, until soft, 6 minutes. Add the beets, tomato paste, 1 tbsp of the vinegar, and the sugar and cook, stirring, until the beets darken and the paste coats them, 6 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add 8 cups water, the potatoes, bay leaves, 2 tsp salt, and the pepper. Bring to a boil over high, about 8 minutes, then cover and simmer on medium-low 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add cabbage and beans
steps.body: Stir in the cabbage and beans and simmer, partly covered, until the cabbage and potatoes are tender, 10 minutes.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Remove the bay leaves. Stir in the garlic, the remaining 2 tbsp vinegar, the remaining 1/2 tsp salt, and half the dill; taste and balance with more vinegar or a pinch of sugar. Ladle into bowls, top with the rest of the dill, and serve the rye bread alongside.
